title: Drawer
summary: A drawer for the cabinet, with a baseplate grid inside for bins. Make it with the same width, depth and bin height as the cabinet.

groups.title: Size
groups.help: Use the same drawer width, depth and bin height as your cabinet: the drawer is sized from them to fit its rails.

groups.title: Front
groups.help: The pull is a lip along the top of the front, with a 45° underside so it prints without supports.

groups.title: Floor
groups.help: Solid floor under the grid inside.

params.label: Width
params.help: Grid squares inside, across the front. Same as the cabinet's drawer width.

params.label: Depth
params.help: Grid squares inside, front to back. Same as the cabinet's drawer depth.

params.label: Bin height
params.help: Height of the bins it holds, in 7 mm units. Same as the cabinet's bin height.

params.label: Pull
params.help: A finger lip along the top of the front.

params.label: Pull width
params.help: Width of the pull, centred on the front.

params.label: Floor thickness
params.help: Solid floor under the grid inside.

checks.message: The pull is wider than the drawer front: make it narrower.
